description: The plot titled “Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-3” shows how the sparsity ratio of SDPA output values below a 1e-3 threshold varies across transformer layers for three conditions. The x-axis is labeled “Layer,” uses a linear scale, and spans integer layers from 0 to 23 with major ticks shown at 0, 5, 10, 15, and 20. The y-axis is labeled “Sparsity Ratio,” uses a linear scale, and runs from 0.0 up to about 0.8 with evenly spaced tick marks at 0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, and 0.8. A blue dashed line (legend: “sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.003”) stays very close to zero across all layers, starting around ~0.01 at layer 0 and approaching ~0.00 by the final layers. An orange dotted line (legend: “sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.126”) starts high near ~0.85 at layer 0, drops steeply over early layers (around ~0.40 by layer 2 and ~0.15 by layer 5), then continues decreasing to low values around ~0.02–0.03 by roughly layers 12–16, followed by small fluctuations including a visible bump in the late layers (around ~0.07 near layer ~21) and ending near ~0.04 at layer 23. A green dash-dot line (legend: “sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.080”) begins near ~0.80 at layer 0, declines sharply through the first few layers (around ~0.25 by layer 2 and ~0.08 by layer 5), then gradually decreases toward near-zero values by the mid-to-late layers (around ~0.02 near layer 10 and ~0.00–0.01 by layers ~15–23).
caption_used: Proportion of SDPA output values below the threshold of 1e-3 across transformer layers, illustrating the impact of gating mechanisms on sparsity. The x-axis, labeled 'Layer,' spans from 0 to 23 on a linear scale, while the y-axis, labeled 'Sparsity Ratio,' ranges from 0.0 to 0.8. The blue dashed line, representing sparsity before gating, remains consistently near 0.05 across all layers, indicating minimal inherent sparsity. The green dash-dot line, depicting sparsity after applying the gating mechanism, starts at approximately 0.8 at layer 0 and declines sharply, stabilizing around 0.05 by layer 10. The orange dotted line, representing sparsity after multiplying the average gating score with pre-gating hidden states, initially mirrors the green line but plateaus at roughly 0.25 from layer 5 onward and exhibits a pronounced resurgence, peaking at 0.2 near layer 22. Notably, the gating mechanism substantially amplifies sparsity in early layers, while the averaged gating approach consistently underperforms relative to direct gating in later layers.
